avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces dantrolene plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; both agents can cause liver injury and additive hepatic stress

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase dantrolene levels; effect less pronounced than grapefruit juice
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased muscle weakness or adverse effects; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential hepatoprotective effects; theoretical risk of additive hepatic effects
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and monitor liver function tests periodically

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases dantrolene bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption; choose alternative beverages (orange juice, water)

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase dantrolene absorption and peak plasma levels
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain uniform dietary pattern

monitoring_notes: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) regularly as dantrolene carries hepatotoxicity risk; assess for excessive muscle weakness, sedation, or signs of hepatic impairment. Counsel patients on adherence to consistent dosing schedule and avoidance of hepatotoxic substances.
